results.title: China carmakers outmaneuver Japan rivals in Myanmar with EV policy - Nikkei Asia
results.snippet:
YANGON -- Chinese automakers are surging ahead in Myanmar, with BYD and three other companies tapping electric vehicle incentives to begin production in the country, creating obstacles for Japanese rivals.
